# 50 Five-Star Hotels

50 Five-Star Hotels is a travel guide to affordable five-star and near-five-star hotels around the world.

Core positioning: five-star hotels without five-star prices.

The site focuses on:
- affordable five-star hotels
- cheap five-star hotels worth considering
- luxury hotels on a budget
- best-value five-star hotels
- how to find elite stays by country
- honest five-star classification
- price tiers under €50, under €100, under €200, and under €250
